title: Local smoothing in three dimensions

result.label: Local smoothing in three dimensions
result.statement: Resolves Sogge's local smoothing conjecture for the Euclidean wave equation in three spatial dimensions. The estimate holds throughout the full strict range 2 p , with Sobolev regularity above 0,1-3/p . In particular, the critical L 3 estimate holds with every positive Sobolev loss.
